Sibling-temp chosen over write-once because both creating bodies read/validate/roll back through the on-disk path. Added cases fp7 (body inspecting the real path while it runs sees no file; plan lands at real name with no .creating), fp8 (raising body leaves neither), fp9 (refusing body leaves neither) in test_audit_task.py _first_plan_cases.
